Jamie: hey team, Jamie here! first day, M1 MacBook Pro. using fish. trying to bootstrap with asdf (python/node/rust) + dotfiles. asdf fails compiling python with openssl errors. ssh-agent keys drop after reboot. 1Password CLI prompts for SSO but no vault access yet. who to ping for Okta/vpn/git access? any fish-specific tips appreciated.

Ravi: welcome :wave: on Apple Silicon I do `brew install openssl@1.1` (or @3) and export flags so builds find it, e.g. in fish config: `set -x LDFLAGS (printf -- "-L%s/lib" (brew --prefix openssl@1.1))` and similar for CPPFLAGS. then `env CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl=$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)" asdf install python 3.11.5` worked for me.

Ravi: for nodejs plugin you must import GPG keys once: `curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs/master/bin/import-release-team-keyring | bash` then add plugin and install.

Lina: for ssh-agent + fish, add a tiny conf.d script: create `~/.config/fish/conf.d/ssh-agent.fish` with `if not set -q SSH_AUTH_SOCK; eval (ssh-agent -c); ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519; end`. that keeps it across restarts on mac.

Lina: 1Password; ping me (Lina) with your work email and I'll add you to the org vault. then run `eval (op signin redwood --output=env)` in fish. we keep sample envs in the handbook — don't commit secrets.

ITSupport: Jamie, open a ticket at https://itsupport.redwood.internal/new or post your manager's email here and I can create the Okta/Git access. ETA ~1-2 business days.

dev_onboard_bot: Checklist created for Jamie: [ssh-key, add-to-1password, clone-dotfiles, install-asdf-runtimes, request-vpn] (0/5).

Jamie: thanks all 60a did the brew + configure opts trick and python built. ssh-add persisted after adding to keychain. invited to Okta is pending. one question: do we default to using devcontainers for services?

Lina: use devcontainer when present; otherwise local Docker or native tooling is fine. tag @Lina for devcontainer breakage. welcome aboard!

Jamie: great, thanks everyone :heart:
